newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan's Hub Power gains 2.17 percent.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan's Hub Power gains 2.17 percent.

text.p: Pakistan's Hub Power Company Ltd jumped 0.70 rupees, or 2.17 percent, to 32.95 on Thursday, mainly on foreign buying, dealers said.
The stock emerged as the volume leader with a turnover of over 1.2 million shares in early trade.
"This is the only stock which has not shed value despite the sharp falls in the index," dealer Shakil Anwar said.

Dealer Ather Raouf said Hub Power guarantees fixed returns and is among the few attractions for local and foreign investors. "Today there is foreign interest in Hub Power as the stock is at attractive levels," he added.
